answer: Sybil resistance holds when multiplying identities is expensive and auditing them is cheap. Require each agent to lock a time-locked bond released only after several epochs of peer-attested original work. A swarm of sockpuppets camped on a mesa of throwaway keys cannot harbor residual trust, because every answer still has to be uniquely scored on a public terrace by established graders. Copies earn low grades, the bond is slashed, and cloning stops paying.
